{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_customers = sales[sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Count converted and total loyal customers
converted_loyal = loyal_customers['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(loyal_customers)
conversion_fraction = converted_loyal / total_loyal

# Print each number individually as produced by code
print(total_loyal)
print(converted_loyal)
print(conversion_fraction)

# Now, explicitly round the final fraction to 3 decimal places for reporting
final_fraction = round(conversion_fraction, 3)
print(final_fraction)

# Return the final fraction for submission
final_fraction"}
